title: Research: noncommuting sign-quotient restoration and kernel checkpoints
head: 9dba8f255b5c491f08caf720664f13e19a99067f
body:
Six fixed children with noncommuting S3 workspace drift can carry restoration through a one-row sign-character output. The complete source-only dirty echo uses **240 ADD/NEG instructions instead of 372**, including both source calls, every child/inverse and arbitrary dirty-state restoration. Its exact boundary minimum is six output negations in the declared complete group-operation alphabet.

The nonfaithful representation also separates observer contracts: canonical output after child two costs **6**, while canonical workspace there costs **30**. The package contains the written admission/transport and minimum-boundary proofs, both literal root words, exact invoices and an opt-in replay hook. It adds only `research/noncommuting-quotient-restoration/` and leaves the selected frontier unchanged.

**Validation:** the registered CPython 3.12.14 replay and nine optimized package test groups pass; CPython 3.14.6 normal and optimized checks agree. Evidence covers all 46,656 endpoint-correct normalized schedules including entrance, 729 ternary readers, five observer policies at three tariffs, 624 forward/inverse basis columns, twelve rational probes, twelve semantic controls, source/receipt corruption and relocation.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/noncommuting-quotient-restoration
```

**Scope:** exact characteristic-zero, fixed indivisible children and complete group/output corrections. Opening the toy children permits cheaper direct evaluation. No actual supplier with this contract is identified, no full multiplication proof or new kappa is claimed, and physical hosting/frames, rounded precision/tape, all-size compilation and analytic transfer remain unrun. Word-address movement and access counts are supplied; they are not bit-tape timings.

Started from fresh main `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`, chooser nonce `d43d0282092e46edce787623f2f939e8`, refined persistent-boundary card. Submission main `680967accfd4311f3241dc154e1f434869747b43` has identical contribution guidance and selected record. Final overlap covers 718 open PRs and 218 Discussion body/comment/reply records with complete pagination; exact source heads, coverage and limitations are in TASK.json, PREDECESSORS.json, OVERLAP.json and VALIDATION.md. [Coordination claim and result](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1381).

Credit Ross Richardson PR1287, Sagar Thakrar PR1227/1199, PR1145's six-ADD cycle, mightyOil PR1203, Adam Gall PR1205, Aaron Wang/Navinor PR1155, PR889 and the retained lineage. Concurrent Hanson Sun / bbMisk PR1488 (`13d780ea51248ddd51901cd546b9f59adc76eb43`) gives faithful two-dimensional S3 transport and explicitly distinguishes this sign quotient. General noncommuting output transport is shared concurrent work; this contribution is the nontrivial kernel checkpoint and its precise fixed-reader price. PR1488 is credited, not replayed.

Prepared for **@Arham-Tahir64** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance** in algebra, implementation, verification and prose. New material is Apache-2.0; immutable predecessor notes and their attribution are retained. No independent human review or hosted CI pass is claimed.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
